import HartshorneLib.Chapter4OrderComparison

/-!
# Local factorization with prescribed order

At a non-generic point of a smooth integral curve, a nonzero rational function
is a local unit times a power of any specified uniformizer. The exponent is
the integer order used by the curve's principal divisor. The local unit
depends on the specified parameter; the exponent is intrinsic.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- The exponent in a local unit-times-uniformizer factorization is the
classical integer order of the rational function. -/
theorem orderZAt_toAdd_eq_of_unit_mul_zpow
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (g : X.left.functionFieldˣ) (n : ℤ) (a : (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)ˣ)
    (hg : (g : X.left.functionField) =
      algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField (a : _) *
        algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t ^ n) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom hx g) = n := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  letI : Smooth X.hom := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth 1 X.hom
  letI : IsLocallyNoetherian X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian X.hom
  rw [orderZAt_toAdd_eq_log_ordFrac X.hom g hx, hg, map_mul,
    Ring.ordFrac_of_isUnit a.isUnit, one_mul, map_zpow₀, Ring.ordFrac_irreducible ht]
  simp

/-- For a specified local parameter, every nonzero rational function has a
local unit factor after removing the power prescribed by its integer order. -/
theorem exists_unit_mul_parameter_orderZAt
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (g : X.left.functionFieldˣ) :
    ∃ a : (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)ˣ,
      (g : X.left.functionField) =
        algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField (a : _) *
          algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField t ^
            Multiplicative.toAdd (orderZAt X.hom hx g) := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  obtain ⟨n, a, ha⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_units_eq_smul_zpow_of_irreducible
    ht g.ne_zero
  simp only [Units.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def] at ha
  exact ⟨a, (orderZAt_toAdd_eq_of_unit_mul_zpow X hx t ht g n a ha).symm ▸ ha⟩

end Hartshorne
